name: Ember Instrument
pitch: Your coding history, illuminated as a precision instrument.
tradeoff: The theatrical dial uses space that a denser analytical view could put to work.
fontWhy: Sora gives the instrument its identity, Manrope keeps labels calm, and DM Mono stabilizes every digit.
logoIdea: An open orbit curls into its own luminous trace, ending in a single point of light.
sliderIdea: Two illuminated brass grips select days over a miniature activity histogram.
signatureMotion: The dial breathes softly; its amber arc sweeps to the selected token volume.
